capabilities.body: ʻOku palani ʻe OpenAmer ha ngāue, fakahoko ia ʻaki e ngaahi meʻangāue moʻoni — tēminale, palausa, faile mo e kouti — pea tauhi ʻa e meʻa naʻe ola lelei.
capabilities.title: Ko ha fakafofonga ʻoku fakakaukau fakataha mo koe

capabilities.body: ʻOku tauhi ʻa e ngaahi fepōtalanoaʻaki, manatu mo e mōtolo ʻi he mīsini ni. ʻOku ʻikai ʻave ha meʻa tuku kehe kapau te ke kole.
capabilities.title: Ko hoʻo meʻangāue, ko hoʻo fakamatala

capabilities.body: Ngaahi lea ʻe 186, takitaha ʻi he faʻahinga mataʻitohi ʻokú ke lau. ʻOku ʻeke atu ʻi he ʻuluaki peesi ʻo e polokalama ʻa e lea te ke fili.
capabilities.title: Ko hoʻo lea, ʻi he founga totonu

capabilities.body: ʻOku tauhi e ngaahi poto mei he ngāue tonu, ko ia ʻoku vave ange ai e ngaahi ngāue fakaʻaho ʻi he lahi ange hoʻo fakaʻaongaʻi ia.
capabilities.title: Malava ʻoku tupulaki

help: Vakaiʻi pe ʻoku lava ʻa e mīsini ni ʻo fetuʻutaki ki he ʻinitaneti.
Toe fakahoko e teuteu — he ʻikai toe fai e ngaahi sitepu kuo ʻosi.
Kapau ʻe taʻelava tuʻo ua, fakaava e ngaahi lekooti; ʻoku fakahā ʻe he ngaahi laine fakaʻosi ʻa e sitepu.
failure.lead: Naʻe ʻikai fakafoki fakalongolongo ha liliu — ʻoku tuʻu ʻa OpenAmer ʻi he feituʻu naʻe ngata aí, ko ia ʻe hoko atu mei ai ʻi hono toe fakahoko.
failure.leadUpdate: ʻOku kei ʻi he tatau motuʻa ʻa OpenAmer pea kei ngāue pē. Naʻe ʻikai fakahoko fakakonga ha fetongi.
failure.title: Naʻe ʻikai ʻosi e teuteu

language.lead: ʻE hoko atu e teuteu ʻi he lea te ke fili ʻi hení. Te ke lava ʻo liliu ia kimui ʻi he polokalama.
language.title: Fili hoʻo lea

progress.lead: Teuteu tuʻo taha: ʻOku tukuhifo ʻe OpenAmer ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ne fiemaʻu pea fokotuʻutuʻu ʻa e mīsini ni. He ʻikai toe fai ia ʻi he ngaahi fakaava ka hoko.
progress.leadUpdate: ʻOku fetongi ʻe OpenAmer ʻa e tatau motuʻa. ʻOku ʻikai liliu hoʻo ngaahi taimi ngāue, manatu mo e fokotuʻutuʻu.
progress.stepsComplete: Kuo ʻosi e sitepu ʻe {done} mei he {total}
progress.title: ʻOku teuteuʻi ʻa OpenAmer

cards.body: Fakaava e polokalama pea fakamatalaʻi e meʻa ʻokú ke loto ke fai. ʻOku ngāue ʻa OpenAmer ʻi mui pea fakahā atu e ola.
cards.title: Kamata ʻaki ha sētesi

cards.body: Fokotuʻutuʻu → Fakaʻaliʻali → Lea. Ngaahi fili fakafeituʻu ʻe 186, te ke lava ʻo liliu ʻi ha taimi pē.
cards.title: Fili hoʻo lea

cards.body: ʻOku hoko e ngāue ʻoku toutou fai ko ha poto — ʻi he kahaʻú ʻoku fiemaʻu pē ha fekau ʻe taha.
cards.title: Tuku ke ne manatuʻi

bullets: ʻOku ngāue ʻi hoʻo mīsini — ʻoku nofo pē hoʻo ngaahi fepōtalanoaʻaki ʻi he mīsini ni

welcome.lead: Ko hoʻo fakafofonga pē ʻaʻau. ʻI hoʻo meʻangāue. ʻI hoʻo lea.
welcome.leadUpdate: Kuo mateuteu ha tatau foʻou ange ʻo OpenAmer. ʻE fetongi ʻe he meʻá ni e tatau motuʻa pea tauhi e ngaahi taimi ngāue mo e fokotuʻutuʻu kotoa.
welcome.note: ʻOku fiemaʻu ha ngaahi miniti siʻi ʻi ha fetuʻutaki angamaheni.
welcome.title: Talitali lelei ki OpenAmer
